title: the recompile gate runs a python that runs, from the repo root
intention: recompile_gate.sh runs the lab compile from the repo root with the first interpreter that actually runs Python 3, in the order bin/ resolves it (the venv's bin/python3, its Scripts/python.exe, then python3, python, py), so a stub python3 or an absent venv never stops the lab from recompiling.
why: On akienyoga9i, python3 is the MS Store stub and ~/.cairn/venv is absent, so every post-merge poke logs 'recompile-gate FAILED' and the lab never regenerates (orchestrator, 2026-11-16). Reproduced here: under a stub python3 the gate exits 0, logs the stub's message, and writes 0 lab files. A second defect sits behind it: REPO is $HERE/../.., the cairn package dir, and from there a python with no venv cannot import cairn. Only the venv's editable install hid that.
traces_to: Law 7 (the FAILED line is permanent in the record and repeats on every merge) and Law 1 (/intent consults the lab, so a lab that never recompiles makes the next mind re-derive the settled).
how: In recompile_gate.sh, point REPO at $HERE/../../.., and add a resolver carrying the order of cairn/devices/recovery/bootstrap.sh's cairn_python and _cairn_host_python. It is cited, not sourced: recovery publishes only cairn_wire_instances (RULE 1). When none runs, the gate exits 0 and logs FAILED naming the candidates tried. Red-first proof beside test_recompile_gate.py.

clauses.claim: with no venv, python3 on PATH a stub that exits 9009 and python the host interpreter, the gate writes the lab and its log gains no FAILED line
with every PATH name a stub and a venv whose bin/python3 is a wrapper over the host interpreter, the gate runs the wrapper and writes the lab
with no venv and every PATH name a stub, the gate exits 0 and logs a FAILED line saying no Python 3 interpreter was found

decisions.text: D1: recompile_gate.sh sets REPO to $HERE/../../.. (the repo root, as its comment already says). A _gate_python function tries ${CAIRN_VENV:-$HOME/.cairn/venv}/bin/python3, then .../Scripts/python.exe (each if executable), then python3, python, py (each only if it runs `import sys; sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info[0]==3 else 1)` and exits 0). It runs the existing compile body with that interpreter. With none, it appends '<date> recompile-gate FAILED: no Python 3 interpreter found (tried ...)' and exits 0. Install mode and hooks/post-merge are unchanged.

D2: the proof runs the gate under env -i in scratch worlds (cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir), with PATH of stub scripts plus links to sys.executable, and with CAIRN_VENV, CAIRN_LOG_DIR, CAIRN_LAB_OUT, CAIRN_COMMONS_ROOT and CAIRN_CODE_ROOT set. One tooth per clause; PROVES keys 1..3. Siblings re-run: test_recompile_gate.py, test_a_merge_recompiles_the_lab.py.
